endorsements.name: Stefan Petrushevski
endorsements.label: CVE-2019-25231
endorsements.description: devolo dLAN Cockpit 4.3.1 contains an unquoted service path vulnerability in the 'DevoloNetworkService' that allows local non-privileged users to potentially execute arbitrary code. Attackers can exploit the insecure service path configuration by inserting malicious code in the system root path to execute with elevated privileges during application startup or system reboot.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 4.0, 8.5)

endorsements.name: Stefan Petrushevski
endorsements.label: CVE-2019-25249
endorsements.description: devolo dLAN 500 AV Wireless+ 3.1.0-1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows attackers to enable hidden services through the htmlmgr CGI script. Attackers can enable telnet and remote shell services, reboot the device, and gain root access without a password by manipulating system configuration parameters.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: CRITICAL (CVSS 3.1, 9.8)

endorsements.name: Stefan Petrushevski
endorsements.label: CVE-2019-25250
endorsements.description: Devolo dLAN 500 AV Wireless+ 3.1.0-1 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability that allows attackers to perform administrative actions without proper request validation. Attackers can craft malicious web pages that trigger unauthorized configuration changes by exploiting predictable URL actions when a logged-in user visits the site.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 5.3)
